definitions: Rods or sticks used for the purpose of whipping or flogging someone as a form of punishment or torture.
A device or instrument, typically a bundle of flexible sticks or canes, used to administer corporal punishment.
examples: The historical museum displayed various forms of punishment, including whipping rods.
In some ancient cultures, whipping rods were a common tool for discipline.
The old texts described the use of whipping rods for minor offenses.
